identity.name: PINDER-S
identity.primary_workload: 93 PINDER-S complexes with both primary apo monomers

found_basis: Public source includes baseline adapter, executable docking stage commands and evaluator; required material URLs and completed retrieval inventory supplied in readable brief. Execution not tested.
outcome_definition: Recovery of experimentally observed protein-protein interfaces from apo docking; measure top-ranked and best-of-fixed-candidate quality separately, with throughput, wall time, cost and time to acceptable pose.

citations.title: PINDER: The Protein INteraction Dataset and Evaluation Resource
FRODOCK: a new approach for fast rotational protein-protein docking

source_licences.item: PINDER 2024-02 dataset, index, metadata and mappings
source_licences.reason: Repository advertises Apache-2.0; no fetched statement explicitly extends that licence to separately hosted dataset and all derived inputs.

source_licences.item: FroDock mirror software and bin/soap.bin scoring input
source_licences.reason: Official download/licence route returns HTTP 404. Mirror README requests citations but does not establish a grant covering software and scoring input. Owner authorizes mirror use; this does not establish upstream rights.
RCSB Usage Policies explicitly cover data files in PDB archive under CC0 1.0; local scientific redocking permitted.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image specification absent; no build or workload run. Linux amd64 GNU/MPI/FFTW baseline appears portable but compatibility remains untested.
requirements: fastpdb wheels require Linux glibc >=2.34; otherwise Rust build
FroDock CPU/MPI baseline; CUDA acceleration is experimental scope, not published baseline requirement
source_issues: Dockerfile WORKDIR and archive extraction paths differ; PATH points to /app/frodock/bin although tool workdir is /workspace/frodock.
Adapter concatenates Path directory with binary filenames without slash.
Adapter changes into empty temporary directory without copying inputs.
Adapter uses shutil.copy on literal wildcard and does not check subprocess return codes.
Method CLI uses pd.from_csv and compares string enum values with enum members.

size.reason: Inventory byte sizes available, but selected-case resident structures, docking grids, per-process working set and output storage unmeasured. Complete training dataset size does not describe selected benchmark.
size.inventory_scope: All supplied inventory rows, including optional auxiliary files and archives; not required resident working set.

scoring.ranking: Report top-ranked pose separately from best DockQ among a fixed preregistered candidate count; retain failures in case accounting.
scoring.candidate_count_reason: Brief requires a fixed number but supplies no number; inspected adapter requires n_solutions without a default. Must preregister before execution.
scientific_limits: AAV separated components support redocking only, not independently unbound docking.
Docking accuracy does not establish BBB transcytosis, binding affinity or therapeutic relevance.
Published-value checks cannot authenticate FroDock mirror against original study bytes.

repeatability.case_selection: Fixed complete set of 93 paired-primary-apo PINDER-S cases, not a random smaller subset; retain official IDs.
repeatability.reason: Independent seeds requested by brief, but values and repeated-run count unspecified; FroDock adapter exposes no seed argument.
repeatability.material_pins: data.json includes complete brief inventory and recorded hashes. Dependencies not fully pinned; historical-study equivalence unresolved.

gate_scripts.reason: Prompt names no gate scripts; validate required JSON keys, anchor schema and consistency locally.
